findings.issue_text: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests, so background jobs and mailers using translate skip an unloaded site-default locale and return English or missing translations despite available site-language translations; the translation path must load fallback locales because the fallback backend does not invoke the custom locale loader.

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests, so background jobs and mailers using translate skip an unloaded site-default locale and return English or missing translations despite available site-language translations; the translation path must load fallback locales because the fallback backend does not invoke the custom locale loader.

adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue: `ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` within `application_controller.rb`, which only runs during HTTP requests. Background jobs and mailers that use I18n.translate would not trigger this controller method. Looking at the diff, the `translate` method in `translate_accelerator.rb` only loads `config.locale` but doesn't load fallback locales. The `FallbackLocaleList` class provides fallbacks like `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`, but if the site default locale isn't loaded (because `ensure_loaded!` wasn't called), translations in that locale won't be found. The fallback backend will try to look up translations in fallback locales, but if those locale files aren't loaded, it will skip to the next fallback (English). This is a legitimate bug where background jobs could return English translations instead of site-default locale translations.
